metadata.title: Anonymised vibration, lubricant and availability dataset for multimodal condition-based maintenance of tugboat propulsion systems
metadata.description: Anonymised supporting dataset for a Reliability Engineering & System Safety manuscript on vibration-led multimodal condition-based maintenance decision support for tugboat propulsion. The package contains processed diagnostic tables, representative spectral features, SSS/ODI/LTI data, diagnostic-zone economic data, final figures and Python scripts. Commercially sensitive vessel names, operator identity, port schedules and contract-specific records are withheld under confidentiality agreements. Zenodo DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20101612.
